description: Sort stakeholders on a power/interest grid (Mendelow's matrix) into Manage Closely, Keep Satisfied, Keep Informed, and Monitor, with what to do for each group. Returns a link that opens the finished map in Retainer's free stakeholder mapping tool. Scores are relative: what matters is where people sit compared to each other, not the exact number.

interest.description: 0-100. How much the outcome affects them or how closely they are paying attention. 50 or more counts as high.

name.description: Person's name and/or role, e.g. "Dana Lee (CFO)".

note.description: Optional short note, e.g. what they care about.

power.description: 0-100. Ability to help or block the outcome: budget authority, veto power, organizational influence. 50 or more counts as high.

title.description: Optional map title, e.g. the client or project name.

name: map_stakeholders
title: Map stakeholders (power/interest grid)
